Quantum 1.7.0 was certified on 2026-07-15. It pins **nucleus v1.3.1**, **quark v1.3.0** and **orbit v1.4.1**.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.6.0: nucleus goes from v1.3.0 to v1.3.1 (patch), quark goes from v1.2.2 to v1.3.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.4.0 to v1.4.1 (patch).
